analysis.description: The paper proposes a constrained optimization approach to achieve controlled sparsity in neural networks during training. The method aims to overcome challenges associated with sparsity-inducing penalties that require extensive tuning. Using a gate mechanism for controlling sparsity, it offers reliable control of model density across various architectures and datasets without compromising predictive performance.

type.justification: The paper includes extensive experimental validation on different datasets and architectures, which indicates an empirical study.
type.quote: Experiments on CIFAR-{10, 100}, Tiny-ImageNet, and ImageNet using WideResNet and ResNet{18, 50} models validate the effectiveness of our proposal and demonstrate that we can reliably achieve pre-determined sparsity targets without compromising on predictive performance.
